notice.title: Before you build or fly
notice.SN-1: Charge LiPo packs only with a balance charger, never unattended, in a fireproof bag or box. Retire a swollen or damaged pack. Store near 3.8 V per cell.
notice.SN-2: Take propellers off for every bench test. Wear eye protection when flying. Never try to catch a flying drone.
notice.SN-3: A battery pack can deliver very high current into a short circuit. Power a new build the first time through a current-limited supply or a smoke stopper.
notice.SN-4: This craft is stable because the simulation says so. A real craft with the same numbers may not be.
notice.SN-5: Test in this order: props off, then a tether or very low hover over soft ground, then open space away from people.
notice.SN-6: Registration, Remote ID, height limits, line-of-sight and age rules depend on where you fly. Check your national authority. This simulator does not make anyone legal to fly.
notice.SN-7: Autonomous modes here are teaching models. They do not detect obstacles, people or other aircraft.
notice.SN-8: This simulation is a teaching tool, not an official sign-off on a design. It does not predict that a real aircraft will fly, or fly safely.

band.fit: Within the range of your datasheet rows: about 9 in 10 of your own rows fall inside this band. It says nothing about how well the rows match a real part.
band.none: No datasheet rows were given, so there is nothing to check this against.
band.outside: This build lies outside the range of your datasheet rows, so the band does not apply here.
